decisions.reason: An online customer portal is a strategic service investment that supports customer retention and process efficiency, so a medium-sized established manufacturer would usually continue it once launched.
An award-winning cardboard packaging display solution is highly likely to be kept because the 2024 packaging prize gives it strong marketing value and signals good market acceptance.
A quarter-pallet cardboard pegboard display fits closely with the firm's core POS display business and its own product page suggests active commercial support rather than an imminent withdrawal.
A small cardboard counter display is a standard, low-risk format in promotional packaging and is likely to remain part of the firm's offering after launch.
A large freestanding cardboard information display is a natural extension of the firm's cardboard display portfolio and dedicated website presentation indicates it is being actively marketed.
